question: Can fixed rank-test conventions or the source workbook explain the two residual open-field and IFITM3 discrepancies without changing observations?
decision: Narrow possible source/software explanations and explicitly retain any unresolved reported-statistic mismatch.
strongest_rival: Attrition, mislabeled panels/scales, mixed doses, shared normalization and absent stable mouse IDs can overstate treatment evidence.
discriminator: Two previously identified residuals; immutable S4 coordinates, independent pairwise U, exact v2 cross-check, complete untied exact P support and workbook formula audit.
exposure_record: All original data, v1/v2 diagnostics and the two residual endpoints were exposed before this amendment. No new endpoint selection from current results; no confirmatory inference.
biological_unit: Individual mouse within each panel as documented by legends; source coordinates are not cross-assay mouse identities.
nesting_and_overlap: Sections averaged within mice. Two neurogenesis/FACS blocks retained. Combined nesting reuses high/low cohorts with WT only high. Cognition panels share original cohort but have different attrition; no per-mouse task join.
population_and_selection: All original listed observations in open-field D25K/control and IFITM3 WT/control only; no row omissions, rounding changes or invented mouse IDs.
contrast: Two residual reported direct comparisons; method-convention comparison, not a new efficacy analysis.
endpoint: Method-specific probabilities, reported-rounding agreement, exact-probability attainability and formula/cached-value discrepancies.
methods: Fixed exact tied-rank tails, tie-corrected normal approximation with/without continuity, diagnostic tie-ignoring normal/exact references with applicability flags; enumerate full untied exact support at observed n/m. Raw OOXML verifies source values and openpyxl reads cached/formula cells.
missingness_and_exclusions: Blank source cells are missing. Exclude only declared summary rows. Preserve published attrition without invented mouse IDs. No dropping data to match a P value or cached mean; ambiguities remain findings.
multiplicity: No new discoveries or selection of a favorable test. Every fixed convention reported; inapplicable tie-ignoring conventions labelled. Matching a rounded P is not proof of author settings.
precision_basis: No justified effect margin or numerical precision basis recovered. No post-hoc power; ambiguous scales and shared normalizers limit further uncertainty claims.
interpretation_limit: Same-source reproduction, not independent replication. No WT cognition, mediation, age interaction, injury repair or unsupported physical-unit conversion. No cross-panel row matching.
stop_rule: Stop on source-coordinate, U-statistic or prior-exact-value disagreement. Do not search exclusions or alter values. Preserve unresolved mismatches.
amendment_reason: After outcome exposure, owner requested the two remaining discrepancies be pursued; bounded source/software diagnostic only, preserving v1/v2 and original observations.
